flagship_project.name: Project Chronos-10: Predictive Micro-Depot Ingestion, Computer-Vision Darkstore Automated Picking & 300-Second Dispatch Pipeline
flagship_project.pillar: Ultra-Fast Micro-Depot Robotics & Automated Pick-Pack-Dispatch Pipeline
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: Zepto's unit economics require pick-and-pack times inside dark stores to drop under 90 seconds. Chronos-10 combines computer vision overhead item tracking, automated pick-path optimization on handheld terminals, and live telemetry dispatch that pairs riders before packing completes.
flagship_project.tech_stack: Go (Dispatch Core), OpenCV / PyTorch (Dark-store Shelf Vision), Redis Cluster (Inventory Reservation), Redpanda, PostgreSQL with Timescale, Kubernetes Edge on Darkstore Minis
flagship_project.kpis: Average pick-and-pack time reduced to 54 seconds; 99.4% on-time delivery rate under 10 minutes; darkstore stock shrinkage reduced by 70%.
